name: Cacibupteryx
sum: Rhamphorhynchine from the Late Jurassic (Oxfordian) Jagua Formation of western Cuba.
wsnote: Not estimated by the describers; said to be relatively large.
holotype: IGO-V 208 — Jagua Formation, Pinar del Río, Cuba.
material: Partial, uncrushed 3D skull (17 cm) and fragmentary left wing.
biology: Lived along the margins of the young Caribbean seaway; rhamphorhynchines were mainly fish-eaters.
author: Gasparini et al. 2004

species.name: Cacibupteryx caribensis
species.author: Gasparini et al. 2004
